note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldiers are dimorphic and no alate is described; one head index of the minor soldier is omitted because of OCR damage; nomenclatural and type-material records, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldiers dimorphic. Major soldier: head capsule yellow to brownish yellow, paler posteriorly; nasus slightly darker; antennae pale yellow to light brown; legs pale yellow; thorax and abdomen dorsally yellow to light brown. Head with a pair of long setae on vertex only, a few minute hairs elsewhere; nasus with numerous hairs at the tip. Body length 3.50–4.60 mm. Head pyriform, slightly longer than wide excluding nasus (1.50–1.80 mm long including nasus, 0.90–1.13 mm long excluding nasus, 0.80–1.07 mm wide, width/head length excluding nasus index 0.89–0.97); in lateral view weakly depressed behind nasus. Nasus cylindrical, slender (0.60–0.77 mm long; nasus length/head length excluding nasus 0.65–0.78). Antennae 12–14-segmented, mostly 12 or 13; segment 3 longer than segment 2, shorter in the 14-segmented condition; segment 4 variable. Mandibles vestigial; lateral spine-like processes extremely minute or absent. Postmentum subhexagonal, widest at middle, posterior sides incurved. Pronotum saddle-shaped, sparsely covered with short hairs, anterior margin sometimes with a few long hairs (0.20–0.24 mm long, 0.46–0.57 mm wide); anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin convex and unnotched. Mesonotum slightly narrower, metanotum as wide as or slightly wider than mesonotum. Minor soldier: rare, generally smaller. Head often narrowed behind antennae and thus narrower. Antennae 11–12-segmented, segment 3 longer and slender. Body length 2.90–3.40 mm, head length including nasus 1.25–1.40 mm, head length excluding nasus 0.68–0.80 mm, head width 0.60–0.67 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic, but size and colour highly variable. Head capsule pale yellow to yellowish brown; thorax and abdomen pale yellow to light brown. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Body length 4.5–5.90 mm. Head capsule suboval, wider than long (0.97–1.20 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.00–1.33 mm wide); Y-shaped suture distinct in large workers. Fontanelle plate suboval. Antennae usually 14-segmented, sometimes 15, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, with long and short hairs; less than half as long as wide (0.25–0.40 mm long, 0.50–0.80 mm wide); anterior margin with a distinct median notch. Mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum wider; posterior margins of both unnotched.
